findings.title: A valid Unicode source relation under a direction directive selects the wrong shipped diagram model
findings.java_mechanism: Java factory selection rejects the Sequence candidate when `left to right direction` is not consumable there, then DescriptionDiagram consumes the database, queue and CommandLinkElement forms. CommandCreateElementFull and CommandLinkElement both resolve the exact quote-cleaned Métrique.v3 Réseau quark; Java XMI records it as ent0002 and the association as ass5.
findings.rust_mechanism: detect_uml_subtype scores `database` and `queue` as both sequence participants and deployment leaves, then adds one more Sequence point for the arrow. Its direction-directive correction applies only when every graph-style competing score, including Deployment, is zero. The no-oracle shipping path therefore chooses Sequence before parse_deployment or the corrected exact endpoint resolver can run.
findings.evidence: checker_06_no_alias_unicode_dot_source_lr.puml plus Java SVG/XMI and Rust SVG/AST
findings.impact: This violates the account's explicit Unicode, source-endpoint and left-to-right perturbation axes and loses the entire Deployment inventory, kind and link event.

findings.title: Unicode quark identity is serialized differently in the shipped SVG
findings.java_mechanism: DescriptionDiagram.cleanId/CucaDiagram.cleanId preserve the Unicode quark model exactly, as the XMI evidence confirms. During SVG painting, however, UGroup.put calls UGroup.fix; its `[^-\w ]` Java pattern replaces accented letters with dots before DATA_QUALIFIED_NAME is written.
findings.rust_mechanism: Rust writes the raw Unicode parser identity into data-qualified-name. Its core quark identity is more literal than Java's SVG metadata, but T14 product parity is the emitted SVG, not the internal AST.
findings.evidence: checker_08, checker_10, checker_14, checker_17 and checker_18 Java SVG/XMI and Rust SVG/AST pairs
findings.impact: The ordered entity inventories have different qualified identities even when their UIDs and link endpoints agree. The account inferred shipped behavior from cleanId alone and omitted Java's serialization stage.

findings.title: Repeated left-to-right dummy reuse produces an extra Rust SVG link event
findings.java_mechanism: Java's parsed model contains all three relations, proven by the three XMI associations, but its shipped SVG paints only lnk5 and lnk6 for the repeated reverse pair under the required left-to-right matrix.
findings.rust_mechanism: Rust AST also correctly contains all three relation events, but the no-oracle SVG paints an additional lnk7. The same output difference occurs with bare Unicode and an ASCII control, so it is not an endpoint spelling artifact.
findings.evidence: checker_08_fresh_bare_unicode_dot_repeated_lr and checker_16_ascii_bare_repeated_lr_control Java SVG/XMI and Rust SVG/AST pairs
findings.impact: The shipped link-event inventory differs on the account's required repeated-reuse and left-to-right axes. This is adjacent rendering behavior rather than a parser-resolution defect, but it was not declared residue and the checker instruction explicitly rejects wrong link events.

findings.title: The central exact-code resolver generalizes across the ordinary identity matrix
findings.evidence: Ten probes pass exact entity/link UID inventories: checker_01..05, checker_07, checker_09, checker_12, checker_13 and checker_15. They cover quoted and bare display collisions, exact aliases, no-alias declarations, spaces, dots, named notes, declaration order, repetition, both endpoint sides and both layout orientations.
findings.notes: Inspection confirms resolve_connection_endpoint returns the quote-cleaned raw code, quoted no-alias declarations retain raw_label as code, unknown relation endpoints use DeploymentNodeKind::Default, and no display-label lookup remains in the explicit relation path.

anti_overfit_audit.evidence: The implementation changes a single identity rule plus Java-cited unknown-kind behavior. Trigger labels occur only in parser tests and the account, not in shipping conditionals. No parity-affecting numeric literal was added.

required_follow_up: Do not accept deployment-link-endpoint-display-independence yet. Preserve this corpus. Correct factory selection for direction directives with shared Deployment/Sequence declaration keywords; model Java UGroup.fix qualified-name serialization for non-ASCII identity; and account for Java's repeated left-to-right SVG link suppression as a separate rendering mechanism before rerunning all probes with a new independent checker.
